clearly.line: And I see it so clearly
stanza: And I see it so clearly
That we play hard
Yes, we love our love
Most of all
But the timing's spent
In this situation circumstance
I'll see you around
The next time you come to town
I'll see you around
The next time you call

clearly.line: I am a vision and I can see clearly
stanza: I am a mountain
I am a tall tree, oh
I am a swift wind sweeping the country
I am a river down in the valley, oh
I am a vision and I can see clearly

clearly.line: White lids, white opals, seeing everything just a little bit too clearly
stanza: The little boy's face lit up with such naked joy
That the sun burned around his lids and his eyes were like two suns
White lids, white opals, seeing everything just a little bit too clearly
And he looked around and there was no black ship in sight
No black funeral cars, nothing except for him the raven
And fell on his knees and looked up and cried out
"No, daddy, don't leave me here alone
Take me up, daddy, to the belly of your ship
Let the ship slide open and I'll go inside of it
Where you are not human
You are not human"

dearly.line: Never thought I'd have to pay so dearly
stanza: The phone don't ring, no, no
And the sun refused to shine
Never thought I'd have to pay so dearly
For what was already mine
For such a long, long time

dearly.songTitle: No One Will Ever Love You
dearly.line: Where is the dream for which I paid dearly?
stanza: Where is the madness that you promised me?
Where is the dream for which I paid dearly?
Full is not heavy as empty
Not nearly my love
Not nearly my love
Not nearly

sincerely.line: Sick with silence, she weeps sincerely
stanza: Lady Godiva, dressed so demurely
Pats the head of another curly-haired boy
Just another toy
Sick with silence, she weeps sincerely
Saying words that have oh-so-clearly been said
So long ago

sincerely.line: And all because they love themselves sincerely
stanza: Tycoons and barrow boys will rob you
And throw you on the side
And all because they love themselves sincerely
And the man holds a bread knife
Up to your throat is four feet wide
And he's anxious just to show you what it's for

yearly.line: January, you pretend to see life clearly, yearly
yearly.lineNext: February is the time that you put the evil eye and the pride aside
